senses.gloss: वामन- + आकृति वामन- + आकृति, adj. dwarf-shaped.
वम्री- + कूट वम्री- + कूट, n. an ant-hill.
वामन- + तनु वामन- + तनु, adj. dwarfbodied.
वाम- + देव वाम- + देव, m. Śiva.
वाम- + लोचन वाम- + लोचन, adj., f. ना, having beautiful eyes, Hit. ii. d. 111.

वम् वम्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To vomit, Man. 4, 121.
 2. To spit out, Rām. 1, 28, 26.
 3. To send forth, Utt. Rāmac. 148, 8.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. वान्त.
 1. Vomited.
 2. Effused, Megh. 20.
 3. One who has vomited, Man. 5, 144.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. वा̆मय; ptcple. of the pf. pass. वमित, Made to vomit.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, To spit out, to vomit, MBh. 3, 15729; figuratively, 3, 1931.
 --Cf. Lat. vomere; ἐμέω; Goth. vamm, macula, ana-vammjan; A.S. wemman, maculare.
वम वम् + अ, m., and f. मी, Vomiting.

वाम वाम,
 I. adj.
 1. Left (not right), Rājat. 5, 97; Megh. 94.
 2. Reverse, adverse, Pañc. ii. d. 87; opposite, Śāk. d. 93 (those who act in an opposite way).
 3. Bad, wicked, crooked, Kir. 11, 24.
 4. Short.
 5. Beautiful, Pañc. i. d. 152.
 II. m.
 1. Śiva.
 2. Kāma.
 3. An udder.
 4. An animal.
 5. A snake.
 III. f. मा.
 1. A woman.
 2. Gaurī.
 3. Lakṣmī.
 4. Sarasvatī.
 IV. f. मी.
 1. A mare, Ragh. 5, 32.
 2. A she-ass.
 3. A young female elephant.
 4. The female of a jackal.
 V. n. Wealth, Chr. 287, 1 = Rigv. i. 48, 1.
 --Cf. O.H.G. winistar; A.S. wynstre.

वमथु वम् + अथु, m.
 1. Vomiting.
 2. Water ejected from an elephant's trunk.

वमन वम् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Vomiting, Lass. 17, 4; taking, getting. Ragh. 15, 29.
 2. An emetic.
 3. Paining.
 II. f. नी, A leech.

वामन वामन (from वाम),
 I. adj.
 1. Dwarfish, Johns. Sel. 96, 79; a dwarf, Johns. Sel. 95, 63; Bhāg. P. 8, 19, title.
 2. Pressed flat or down, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 830 (वामनी-कृत, Pressed down). []
 3. Vile, low.
 II. m.
 1. A name of Viṣṇu (on account of his अवतार in the shape of a dwarf, Bhāg. P. 8, 19).
 2. The elephant that supports the south quarter, Rām. 1, 6, 23.
 III. f. ना, The name of an Apsaras, Lass. 2. ed. 50, 23.
 IV. f. नी, A female dwarf.

वमि वम् + इ,
 I. m.
 1. Fire.
 2. A rogue.
 II.
 1. Vomiting, Suśr. 2, 491, 21.
 2. An emetic.

वम्र वम्र,
 1. m. A proper name, Chr. 297, 15 = Rigv. i. 112, 15.
 2. f. रा and री, A small ant.

वामक वाम + क,
 I. adj. Left, Mālat. 5, 7.
 II. n. A kind of gesture, Vikr. 59, 20.
वामत्व वाम + त्व, n. Disfavour, Mālat. 146, 10.
वामलूर वामलूर (cf. वम्र, वल्मी), m. An ant-hill.
